parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue but introduces potential regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The patch calls `do_3d_projection` within `get_facecolor` and `get_edgecolor`, which may trigger unnecessary re-projections and potentially break existing behavior.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify the fix or ensure that the changes do not introduce new issues.
The added comments could be more descriptive and follow the project's documentation style.
